integration_notes: Load pricebook_materials first, then merge materials_additions (add or override by id).
Hardware placeholders are separate from pricebook materials; include them as a final cost layer after BOM is generated (consumables / fixings).
Install actions produce labour minutes; multiply by contractor hourly rate ($75/h ex-GST) + any multipliers.
Roof Span (Eave-to-Eave) is the full house-to-front dimension with no overhang (see costing_rules).
v1.2 adds roof_types gable + hip and mixed roof support; see costing_rules + install_actions for new derived drivers (ridge_length_m, acrylic_area_m2).
Multi-pergola: actions now have scope=job|module; overheads_v1.1 contains fixed+variable method for module_count + total_crew_hours.
v1.3: add roof_pitch_deg input (deg) per module; use rafter_length_m (sloped) in acrylic + rafter labour multipliers; logistics access multiplier applied only to offload + setout.
v1.4: mob.* actions are job-scoped; mob.offload_materials and mob.site_survey quantity scales with derived.module_count.
v1.6: infill labour actions now use derived infill drivers (instance count, joiner length/fixings, sheet area, strip panel count, extra supports).
v1.7: crew rate reset to $75/h ex-GST and base labour minutes scaled by 20% to keep install payout approximately neutral.

v1.8: retains the $75/h single-installer crew rate and recalibrates infill actions to include measurement, stock handling, cutting, deburring, edge finishing, drilling, support preparation, full sealing and cleanup.
